name: Bullion Trading MCP
description: Official public MCP of Bullion Trading LLC, a New York bullion dealer: spot prices, catalog prices, premiums, buy-back rates and store policies. Tools are read-only; it can hand the customer a website cart link but cannot place an order.

pricing.free_tier: Public MCP, no API key or sign-in
pricing.details: The MCP itself is public and free to call. Product and buy-back prices are the dealer's live catalog prices; any purchase is completed on the website.

name: Trading Checkup AIKIT
description: Official AIKIT MCP from Trading Checkup: sourced, dated exchange and broker facts (symbol rules, fees, rate limits) and a checker for common mistakes in trading-bot code. Information only; it does not give signals or place orders. Beta; purchasing is not open yet.

pricing.free_tier: Beta; the vendor says buying is not open yet
pricing.details: The vendor states that AIKIT is in beta and that buying is not open yet. Paid plans are also listed as sold on RapidAPI (PRO US$9, ULTRA US$29, MEGA US$99). The free beta key on the vendor page (25 credits, no sign-up, one per network) remains available for trying it out. Tools are metered in credits.

name: Aperiodic MCP
description: Official API and MCP for Aperiodic: point-in-time order-flow, liquidity and funding metrics for crypto and RWA perpetuals (stocks, gold, oil, FX) on Binance, OKX and Hyperliquid, built for AI agents.

pricing.free_tier: Every metric for Q3 2026 on BTC, ETH, SOL and 10 RWA perps; 1,000 requests/day; no card
pricing.details: Free: personal licence, a limited history window (currently every metric for Q3 2026) on BTC, ETH, SOL and 10 RWA perps in hourly to daily bars, 1,000 requests/day, no card. Pro starts at $199/month plus VAT, for independent researchers backtesting order flow (more history and markets). Yearly billing is also offered.

name: Ocarrat Trading Statistics MCP
description: Official MCP for Ocarrat Trading Statistics: OAuth access to a trader's own journal — strategies, weekly reports and performance analytics. A free read-only tier is available. Does not place trades.

pricing.free_tier: Free plan ($0/mo): one strategy, last four weeks, limited read-only agent access
pricing.details: Free includes three read-only MCP tools (list strategies, list weekly reports, performance summary), with monthly caps. Pro is $5/month and adds full history, unlimited strategies and broader agent access. A separate full-access MCP URL exists for Pro journal and coach tools. Cancel anytime.

name: copy.top
description: Official hosted MCP from copy.top (Polycool LLC), also covered by the copytop-signals agent skill: read-only tools, no API key, for live trades, signals and alerts from traders on fomo, pump.fun and Hyperliquid. The product terms also describe a $COPY token with fees, buybacks, burns and invite rewards. The public GitHub repos are documentation stubs and do not include a license.

pricing.details: The hosted MCP is documented as free to call with no key. The consumer product terms also cover copy trading, fees, invites and a $COPY token (fees, buybacks, burns and invite rewards). This listing does not treat those token terms as a price for the MCP itself.

name: StalkChain Data MCP
description: Official hosted MCP from StalkChain for Solana wallet activity, token holders, tracked-trader flows and Hyperliquid market data. Read-only research data plus settings for your StalkChain email alerts. OAuth sign-in; no exchange credentials and, per the vendor, no order placement on this endpoint. The vendor's general /mcp endpoint also offers agent-wallet buy/sell/order tools; this listing links the scoped /mcp/directory endpoint, a connector for partner directories (research data plus email-alert settings), as requested by StalkChain. The MCP Registry record com.stalkchain/data points to the general /mcp surface.

pricing.free_tier: 7-day introductory credit; account setup, connecting, browsing tools and status tools need no card
pricing.details: Starter $29/month (1,500 calls), the same billed monthly or annually. Growth is $79/month billed monthly, or $55/month billed annually (5,000 calls). Pro is $199/month billed monthly, or $139/month billed annually (16,500 calls). The free introductory credit expires 7 days after signup; there is no ongoing free allowance for metered research. Credits roll over.

remote_mcp_url_note: Scoped connector for partner directories (research data plus email-alert settings), as requested by StalkChain; the MCP Registry record com.stalkchain/data points to the general /mcp surface.

name: PtData MCP
description: Official remote MCP and REST API from PtData S.A.: point-in-time US company fundamentals from SEC filings, as known on any past date, each value tied to its filing accession number. Also survivorship-free index members, filing metadata and earnings events. Four read-only tools; the free tier needs no key.

pricing.free_tier: No key or account: 120 requests/min, 200/day per IP (evaluation, non-commercial)
pricing.details: Free needs no account or key and is for evaluation under the terms. Pro $49/month ($490/year) adds commercial use, an API key and 15,000 requests/day; Scale $199/month ($1,990/year) allows 100,000/day. Same data on every tier; billing via Paddle.

name: Lianxiaozhi MCP (链小知)
description: Official hosted MCP from Lianxiaozhi (链小知), a Chinese-language blockchain news site: eight read-only tools for public news, hot-event timelines, daily briefs, reference articles and onchain tool guides. Anonymous access over Streamable HTTP, with no account or API key. Content is in Chinese, partly model-assisted, and is not investment advice. Run by an individual identified only as 王校长 (no legal entity, address or jurisdiction stated); no public repository.

pricing.free_tier: Free; anonymous read-only access, no account or API key
pricing.details: Free. The MCP, REST API v1 and RSS are anonymous and read-only; no account or key is needed. Rate limits and terms are on the vendor's usage-rules page. Content is Chinese-language and aggregated from public sources; it is not investment advice.

name: AlphAI MCP
description: Official hosted MCP from AlphAI, operated by ARDOR 0608 OOD (Bulgaria): financial news scored 1-10 for relevance, with categories and per-ticker impact, plus SEC Form 4 insider trades, earnings, calendar and macro reads. 22 tools, all read-only except the alert tools, which only manage your own alert subscriptions. The GitHub repo holds docs and server.json only; the server is hosted and is reached with an OAuth sign-in or a free API key. The free tier (20 requests/min, 100/day) is for personal, non-commercial use.

pricing.free_tier: 20 requests/min and 100/day on the MCP and REST API, no card; personal, non-commercial use. A free API key is also offered; Radar data has a 60-minute added delay, and the news archive is 30 days.
pricing.details: Free: 20 requests/min and 100/day, personal non-commercial use, with a free API key, a 60-minute added data delay on Radar (site, API and MCP) and a 30-day news archive. Basic is $2.99/month at the early-access price (regular $7.99) with 60/min and 10,000/day, a 15-minute Radar delay and a 90-day archive, and internal commercial use; Pro is $9.99/month early access (regular $24.99) with 150/min and 100,000/day, no added Radar delay and a 180-day archive. Same MCP tools on every plan; longer news archive and alerts on paid plans.

remote_mcp_url_note: The GitHub repo holds docs and server.json only; the server is hosted and needs an OAuth sign-in or a free API key.

name: HPSILab Quant Finance MCP
description: Official hosted MCP, REST API and Python SDK from HPSILab for US stock and options research: implied-volatility structure, options pressure, a 10-trading-day Monte Carlo range, pre-trade risk checks, backtests and a research report. Connect at https://hpsilab.com/mcp with OAuth or a Bearer API key. Research and educational use only; it does not place live broker orders. The open-source MCP package is MIT; the analytics run on the hosted service. Independently operated by Haiyun Hu (Tokyo, Japan).

pricing.free_tier: 100 trial Credits for 14 days after email verification; x402 pay-per-call also available without an account
pricing.details: Web Trader is $5/month (website only, no MCP/API Credits). Trader/Developer is $19/month with 2,000 Credits and an API key for the SDK and MCP. Pro is $99/month with 15,000 Credits.

install_lead.text: A verified free account gets 100 trial Credits for 14 days.

name: ValuEdge Stock Research MCP
description: Official hosted MCP from ValuEdge, operated by lulu digital, for public-equity research: intrinsic-value estimates and assumptions, fundamentals, company comparisons, a bounded stock screener, plus optional OAuth access to your ValuEdge portfolios, watchlists and Smart Alerts. Public ticker discovery can work without sign-in; metered research needs a ValuEdge plan and OAuth. The public repo holds connection docs, not the server implementation. Account tools can edit manual ValuEdge records only after explicit permission; they do not place broker orders, move funds or change broker-synced positions. The public docs repo has no license (recorded as unknown); the hosted service is proprietary.

pricing.free_tier: Free plan, no card: core research, 1 portfolio (up to 10 holdings), 1 watchlist, 3 Valuation Lab uses every 7 days
pricing.details: Free has no card requirement. Premium is $12/month equivalent when billed annually ($144/year); Unlimited is $20/month equivalent ($240/year). Paid plans offer a 7-day trial (card required) and are billed through Paddle. Team access starts at $39/seat/month. Public ticker discovery can work without sign-in; metered MCP research follows the ValuEdge plan and OAuth.

remote_mcp_url_note: The GitHub repo holds connection docs only; the server is hosted and uses ValuEdge OAuth for metered and account tools.

name: Vesper MCP
description: Official hosted MCP from Vesper (lastvesper.com) for options research and paper trading: draft options-selling rules, test them on years of real option quotes, and track them on paper. The public endpoint is https://lastvesper.com/api/mcp/public. Vesper does not itself place, change or cancel broker orders and never sees your broker login. Once trading is on for an account, the assistant can have the user's own broker AI connection place those strategies' trades; Vesper writes the order ticket. The public MCP also exposes account sign-up, sign-in and password-reset tools that take a password as a tool argument, so the password passes through the AI client and chat logs may store it; never reuse a password from another service. Prefer the signed-in connector at https://lastvesper.com/api/mcp, which uses the vendor's sign-in page instead of passing a password to the model.

pricing.free_tier: Free plan with limited daily paper-trading tests; the agent MCP is part of Pro
pricing.details: Free remains available with tight daily limits (for example 1 paper-trading strategy and 5 tests a day). Pro is $29/month, cancel any time, and includes a 30-day free trial with no card. The agent MCP, API access and higher testing limits are part of Pro. Vesper does not itself place, change or cancel broker orders and never sees your broker login. Once trading is on for an account, the assistant can have the user's own broker AI connection place those strategies' trades; Vesper writes the order ticket.

name: Clometrix API
description: Official Clometrix API, operated by Panopedia Pte. Ltd. (Singapore): an economic-release calendar (US and abroad) as JSON, with how far Bitcoin moved in the 15 minutes after each release since 2021, compared with a normal 15-minute stretch. A free account and API key are required (60 requests a minute and 1,000 a day). The data reports what prices did after past releases; it is not investment advice. Terms allow reuse with credit and a link, but not resale as a feed.

pricing.free_tier: Free API key with a free account: 60 requests/minute and 1,000/day
pricing.details: The calendar and reports API is free with an account and a key, at 60 requests a minute and 1,000 a day (429 if you go over). Optional website forecast plans are separate: Lite $39/month, Pro $69/month and Elite $119/month, billed monthly in USD through Stripe. Terms allow reuse with credit and a link, not resale as a feed.

name: Bitpont Public Market-Data API
description: Official Bitpont public market-data API (HTTPS/JSON, OpenAPI 3.1), operated by LIMIT SRL (Romania), for onchain market discovery: listed public reads need no API key or account, subject to documented per-IP and shared quotas. This listing covers those public market reads only. The vendor also offers a remote MCP and wallet-authorized trading workflows (prepare, sign and submit); those are outside this listing, and the API does not automatically sign transactions.

pricing.free_tier: Listed public market reads need no API key or account, subject to documented per-IP and shared quotas (currently 30 request units/minute per IP)
pricing.details: The listed public market-data reads have limited free access without an API key or account, subject to documented client and shared quotas (the docs currently state 30 request units per minute per client IP, and a shared free budget). Extended partner access is manually configured; self-service keys and billing are not offered in this release. This listing does not cover wallet-authorized trading.
